the integration of different acquisition technologies and the use of multi-resolution data are essential for modeling large cultural heritage with complex geometry.

the multi-resolution acquisition and processing of complex and detailed heritage objects is possible, and it is the only viable approach to achieve a good compromise between accuracy and surveying time.
